scope: Same recursive merge-sort algorithm and benchmark source; bounded checked branchless merge emission. No language API change.

diagnosis.source: Identical top-down recursive merge algorithm and RNG/input profile. Both store four-byte elements; positive values make U32 versus I32 ordering identical.

coverage.note: Shared translated algorithms, not identical source or a full-language/50-task claim.

method.cold_build: Fresh driver and compiler per sample; cache disabled. OS and installed-library caches retained. Source staging outside timer. Complete wall and native build phases retained.
method.runtime: Same Node/V8 and flags for both. test/run use official inputs/iterations/warmups. bounded retains production problem sizes with reduced counts recorded per case. Same state retained after warmup. Preparation, startup, engine compilation and output outside clock; no per-element host calls. Two Blot clock packet crossings versus two Goose scalar imports are part of their ABI costs. Common process wall includes parsing the Blot TypeScript guest host for both backends; it is not Goose's standalone runner startup score.
method.representation: Goose byte buffers use U8; Blot stores identical values in U32, 4x element payload bytes; owner and arena overhead are separate. Fixed backing capacities retained. Sort U32 values are nonnegative and preserve I32 ordering; ports restrict sizes to100000/400000, where exact integer RNG conversion matches every Goose F64 RNG state. Mandelbrot uses explicit ordered F32 in BOTH sources; original F64 remains unavailable. Fannkuch indices/permutations are nonnegative; U32 checksum wrap preserves final U32 accumulation. Wider parameter/clock plumbing stays outside kernels. Custom Hash::SHA256 is not cryptographic SHA-256.
method.ordering: Build phase sequential, then runtime phase; seeded paired shuffling, no deliberate concurrent measurement work.

warnings: Fewer than five build samples: compile timings are a pilot only.

diagnosis.wasm_difference: Goose already recognizes a bounded merge loop, validates complete ranges and emits two loads/select/store with Boolean cursor increments. Blot retained checked per-access bounds, branch/reload/store and per-call owner validation.

baseline_profile.method: Node/V8 CPU sampling100us over the whole invocation, including preparation and warmup, restricted to the guest module. Diagnostic attribution, not exclusive measured-kernel timing or hardware counters.

source_diagnostics.note: Diagnostic authored source variants; comparison source remains untouched. Safe native host compiler for pilots; no release compile-time claim. First whole-process sample excluded.

diagnosis.attribution_limit: The measured compiler rewrite combines select, Boolean cursor increments, cached comparison values, unused destination-load removal and smaller transport. No hardware counters separate their individual costs.

implementation.proof: Exact U32 loop shape; two ordered exits, matching indexed reads/stores, distinct scalar cursors/output, invariant limits, complete SSA branch and backedge identities; no additional statements, effects or self-dependent store. Fixed scalar descriptors and unchanged physical owner identities only.
implementation.emission: After all ordinary source/owner/read/escape/backedge checks and suffix-coordinate checks, replace the bounded suffix with checked two-load/select/store emission. Preserve lazy owner validation, source-source-destination check order, all bounds, store-before-increments, aliases, ties, U32 wrap and trap prefixes. Reserve capacity before replacement; reset span and snapshot caches.
implementation.new_internal_opcode: i32_select: exact pure nontrapping(i32,i32,i32)->i32; appended Op tag, encoding0x1b.
implementation.astra_review: No correctness blockers after read-only final review of source proof, carry mapping, checks, aliases, publication and typed encoding.
